summary: "已读懂" belongs to the learning map: with the map switched off it is no longer offered in the library nor shown in the weekly report or profile evidence; with it on, pressing it again takes a mistaken mark back (every record of it still in effect, in one transaction), and after a map revision one press confirms it anew.
scope_note: Worktree understood-toggle from main 829575c. Critical because /api/feedback gains a field (IPC).

budget_impact.rationale: Local feedback records and presentation only; no model call, network or new data leaving the machine.
budget_impact.before: a mistaken 已读懂 could not be taken back; shown with the learning map switched off
budget_impact.after: pressing again retracts; hidden while the map is off

reviews.reviewer: Separate review agent (Opus), read-only; no blocking finding; should-fix items (reconfirmation after a map revision, hiding in weekly/profile, membership check, boolean retract, one transaction, tests) fixed

open_risks: Taking back 已读懂 brings back an older 太难 for the same paper if there was one (the state before the mistaken press); the library does not show 太难.
Checked in Chromium on synthetic data, not in WebKit.
